news_items.title: Rooms To Go Company & Revenue 2014–2026
news_items.summary: ECDB reports that Rooms To Go's online revenue reached $472M in 2024, with a stable growth outlook and a 2.0–2.5% conversion rate, emphasizing its position in Furniture & Homeware e-commerce.
news_items.relevance_reason: Provides insights into Rooms To Go's e-commerce performance and digital strategy.
key_insights: Rooms To Go generated $472M in online revenue in 2024.
The company maintains a 100% first-party assortment.
Conversion rates are estimated between 2.0–2.5%.

key_insights: Rooms To Go plans to increase digital sales beyond 20–25%.

AI-based recommendation engines and dynamic pricing are key strategies.

AR/VR room-planning and AI-assisted design are conversion drivers.
